verdict.rationale: Microsoft's Graph docs show that Teams organizes conversations into channels within teams, and that admins can create a team, add the right people to it, and configure it with channels. That covers channel organization and team-level membership. The pack never mentions private vs. public channels or per-channel membership controls, which are the core of this story. Missing for 10: documented private/public channel types, channel-level membership management, admin UI documentation, independent corroboration.
